search_pursuits.justification: Searches only the authenticated tenant's stored pipeline pursuits and does not change records or contact external destinations.

list_pursuits.justification: Lists stored pursuits in the authenticated GovPeak workspace without changing state.

get_pursuit.justification: Retrieves one tenant-scoped pursuit without modifying it.

get_pursuit_action_items.justification: Retrieves action items already stored for one tenant-scoped pursuit.

get_pursuit_notes.justification: Retrieves existing pursuit notes from the authenticated workspace.

get_pursuit_history.justification: Retrieves the existing activity history for one pursuit without changing records.

get_pursuit_events.justification: Retrieves existing events associated with one pursuit in the authenticated workspace.

list_action_items.justification: Lists action items from the authenticated GovPeak workspace and does not modify them.

list_upcoming_events.justification: Lists stored upcoming GovPeak events in the authenticated workspace.

search_opportunities.justification: Searches GovPeak's bounded, stored federal opportunity corpus; the tool does not browse the public internet at call time or change state.

get_opportunity.justification: Retrieves one record from GovPeak's bounded, stored federal opportunity corpus without changing state.

create_pursuit.justification: Creates a new pursuit only inside the authenticated tenant after write authorization; it does not delete an existing record.

update_pursuit.justification: Updates one or more existing pursuit fields inside the authenticated tenant and can overwrite stored values, so it is marked potentially destructive.

add_pursuit_note.justification: Adds a new dated note to an existing pursuit after write authorization without deleting prior notes.

create_action_item.justification: Creates a new action item inside the authenticated tenant after write authorization without deleting an existing record.

update_action_item.justification: Updates existing action-item fields and can overwrite stored values, so it is marked potentially destructive.
